idea-plugin.name: Raketa Route Index
idea-plugin.description: Finds the controller or handler for a URL across every app of the Raketa monorepo (every app nginx serves: Symfony, Slim, legacy entry points). Also finds console commands of every console (bus:translate-stations, a pasted php api/hotels/cli/sabre sync:api:service). A gutter ▶ on a command class runs or debugs it through any of its consoles: as a PHP Script in PhpStorm, with docker exec in IDEs with another PHP plugin (Raketa with PHP for OpenIDE). A gutter icon on a controller method copies its URL, goes to the route declaration and finds the behat steps calling it; another one opens its request in a scratch .http file of the HTTP Client (PhpStorm's or Raketa's). Ctrl+click on a URL or a stubbed command in a behat .feature step opens its controller. Paste a URL such as https://raketa.in/api/profiles/645701/remarks into Search Everywhere. Routes are dumped by Tools → Rebuild Raketa Route Index into the gitignored .idea/raketa-routes.json.

action.description: Dump routes of every Raketa app into .idea/raketa-routes.json
